programme.title: The Story of Human Rights

programme.desc: The link between the growing use of psychiatric drugs and the explosive rise in mass murders, shootings and suicides is exposed; experts reveal how these drugs are the true cause behind many acts of violence.

programme.title: 30 Rights Brought to Life
programme.desc: A series of public service announcements raises awareness for all 30 of the fundamental human rights specifically guaranteed to every human being by the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.

programme.desc: Morgan Bruiners is an antidrug activist educating youth in South Africa with the Truth About Drugs. As a former drug user, his message on how drugs destroy lives resonates in an area where 70 percent of households are affected by substance abuse.

programme.title: Meet a Scientologist
